function.description: Read one global credential by credential ID and return its credential subtype, such as CLI, HTTP, NETCONF, SNMPv2, or SNMPv3. Use this tool when a specific global credential ID is already known. Do not use it for listing all global credentials or for workflow, task, tag, validation, or device lookups.
function.name: api_get_dna_intent_api_v1_global_credential_id

id.description: Identifier of the specific global credential to read.
